# Trinatech Toners & Printers

> Trinatech Services Ltd is Nairobi's one-stop shop for toners, ink
> cartridges, printers and photocopiers. Based at The One Mall, Ground
> Floor, River Road CBD, Nairobi, Kenya (opposite Nagin Pattni).
> 1,000+ genuine and compatible products from HP, Kyocera, Canon,
> Epson, Ricoh, Brother, Toshiba and Royal. Orders via WhatsApp,
> M-Pesa, cash or bank transfer.

## Key Pages

- [Shop](https://trinatechtonersandprinters.co.ke/shop): Browse toners,
  ink cartridges, printers and copiers with prices in KSh
- [About](https://trinatechtonersandprinters.co.ke/about): Company
  background and location details
- [Blog](https://trinatechtonersandprinters.co.ke/blog): Guides on
  choosing, installing and maintaining toners and printers
- [FAQ](https://trinatechtonersandprinters.co.ke/#faq): Common questions
  about ordering, delivery and compatibility

## Products

Toner cartridges (original and compatible), ink cartridges and bottles,
laser printers, multifunction printers, photocopiers, projectors,
scanners. Royal is our house brand of HP-compatible toners. Delivery
available in Nairobi.
